articles.headline: Oil prices fall and shares jump after US-Iran deal announced
articles.summary: Under the agreement, the key Strait of Hormuz waterway will be reopened, US President Donald Trump said.
articles._summary: Oil prices have fallen and shares risen after the US and Iran said they had agreed a framework deal to end the war, which US President Donald Trump said would see the reopening of the key Strait of Hormuz shipping route. Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, dropped 4.7% to $83.24 (£61.94) a barrel, and shares in Asia and Europe jumped in reaction to the deal. Pakistan, which has been mediating an end to the US-Iran war, said an official signing ceremony would be held on Friday, 19 June in Switzerland. Iran's deputy foreign minister Kazem Gharibabadi confirmed in a phone call on state TV that a deal with the US had been finalised, while Trump posted on social media "let the oil flow!". But Vandana Hari from energy markets analysis firm Vanda Insights said a lack of detail on what has been agreed was "likely to inject unease and uncertainty into the market".
articles._zh_headline: 美伊协议宣布后油价下跌，股价上涨
articles._zh_summary: 在美国和伊朗表示已达成结束战争的框架协议后，油价下跌，股市上涨，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，霍尔木兹海峡的主要航线将重新开放。全球石油基准布伦特原油下跌 4.7%，至每桶 83.24 美元（61.94 英镑），亚洲和欧洲股市因该交易而上涨。一直在调解结束美伊战争的巴基斯坦表示，正式签字仪式将于 6 月 19 日星期五在瑞士举行。伊朗副外长卡泽姆·加里巴迪在国家电视台的电话中证实，与美国的协议已经敲定，而特朗普则在社交媒体上发文“让石油流动吧！”。但能源市场分析公司 Vanda Insights 的 Vandana Hari 表示，协议内容缺乏细节“可能会给市场带来不安和不确定性”。

articles.headline: Crude oil futures drop after Trump promises an Iran deal will be signed Friday
articles.summary: Oil prices had already fallen quite dramatically on Thursday and Friday, in anticipation of an imminent deal. President Trump has posted online that the Strait of Hormuz will reopen after the deal is signed on Friday.
articles._summary: A ship remains anchored on May 16, 2026 in the Strait of Hormuz near Larak Island, Iran. Majid Saeedi/Getty Images Europe hide caption Crude oil prices sank on Sunday night after President Trump posted on social media that a deal to end the war with Iran was "complete." Oil futures markets promptly dropped 4%, after markets reopened for trading following their typical weekend break. Prices had already fallen significantly on Thursday and Friday in anticipation of a deal, bringing the per-barrel price of crude Sunday night down 12% from where it had been in the middle of last week. Brent crude, the global benchmark, is now below $84 a barrel, and West Texas Intermediate, the U.S. benchmark, beneath $81. At one point in this conflict, global oil prices had touched $126 a barrel. They remain elevated compared to pre-war prices, which were in the $60s, but are now cheaper than they have been at any point since the very first days of this conflict.
articles._zh_headline: 特朗普承诺周五签署伊朗协议后原油期货下跌
articles._zh_summary: 2026 年 5 月 16 日，一艘船仍然停泊在伊朗拉拉克岛附近的霍尔木兹海峡。 Majid Saeedi/Getty Images Europe 隐藏标题 周日晚上，特朗普总统在社交媒体上发布结束与伊朗战争的协议“完成”后，原油价格下跌。在典型的周末休市后市场重新开盘后，石油期货市场迅速下跌 4%。由于预期将达成协议，周四和周五价格已大幅下跌，导致周日晚间每桶原油价格较上周中期下跌 12%。全球基准布伦特原油目前低于每桶 84 美元，美国基准西德克萨斯中质原油则低于每桶 81 美元。在这场冲突中，全球油价曾一度触及每桶 126 美元。与战前 60 美元的价格相比，它们仍然处于较高水平，但现在比冲突爆发第一天以来的任何时候都便宜。

articles.headline: Ro Khanna Backs Trump's Iran Ceasefire Deal: 'Democrats Should Support It'
articles.summary: Ro Khanna backs Iran ceasefire and Strait of Hormuz reopening, saying it could lower gas prices, ease inflation.
articles._summary: On Sunday, Rep. Ro Khanna (D-Calif.) said a reported ceasefire involving Iran and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz marks a positive turning point that could ease energy prices and help prevent further military escalation. In a post on X , Khanna praised the reported agreement and urged bipartisan support, arguing that it could stabilize global energy markets and reduce the risk of conflict. He wrote, "The ceasefire agreement with Iran with the opening of the Strait of Hormuz is welcome news. Democrats should support it." He added that the deal reflects mutual respect for sovereignty and helps avoid "a dumb war of choice again." Khanna also criticized past U.S. military actions in the region, saying, "The war was a costly lesson for the US," and claimed earlier efforts at regime change had failed. Comparing it to prior diplomacy, he said, "The terms seem no better than what Obama secured under the JCPOA nearly a decade ago."
articles._zh_headline: 罗·卡纳支持特朗普的伊朗停火协议：“民主党人应该支持”
articles._zh_summary: 周日，众议员罗·卡纳（加利福尼亚州民主党人）表示，据报道，涉及伊朗的停火和霍尔木兹海峡的重新开放标志着一个积极的转折点，可以缓解能源价格并有助于防止军事进一步升级。在 X 上的一篇帖子中，卡纳赞扬了报道中的协议，并敦促两党支持，认为它可以稳定全球能源市场并降低冲突风险。他写道，“随着霍尔木兹海峡的开放，与伊朗达成的停火协议是个好消息。民主党人应该支持它。”他补充说，该协议体现了对主权的相互尊重，有助于避免“再次发生愚蠢的选择战争”。卡纳还批评美国过去在该地区的军事行动，称“这场战争对美国来说是一个代价高昂的教训”，并声称早些时候的政权更迭努力已经失败。他说，与之前的外交相比，“这些条款似乎并不比奥巴马近十年前在联合全面行动计划中获得的条款好。”

articles.author: Ananya Gairola
articles.headline: Trump Says Iran Deal 'Now Complete,' Authorizes 'Opening' Of The Strait Of Hormuz: Crude Falls More than 4%, Dow Futures Jump 380 Points
articles.summary: Stocks rallied and oil prices plunged after Trump announced a framework peace deal with Iran and plans to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
articles._summary: Late Sunday, U.S. stock futures surged and oil prices tumbled as President Donald Trump announced that a framework agreement to end the conflict with Iran had been completed. Dow futures rose 380.00 points, or 0.74%, to 51,607.00, while S&P 500 futures gained 72.25 points, or 0.97%, to 7,507.25 and Nasdaq 100 futures advanced 480.25 points, or 1.62%, to 30,142.25 as of around 8:50 p.m. EDT. In commodities, WTI crude oil fell 4.61% to $80.97 per barrel, while Brent crude declined 3.92% to $83.91 per barrel. Natural gas futures slipped 1.92% to $3.06 per MMBtu. Meanwhile, the U.S. dollar index, which tracks the greenback against a basket of currencies, stood at 99.568, down 0.24%. Asian markets traded sharply higher, with South Korea’s KOSPI surging 5.51% to 8,571.51 and Japan’s Nikkei 225 jumping 4.87% to 69,233.28. Trump said on Truth Social that “The Deal with the Islamic Republic of Iran is now complete.”
articles._zh_headline: 特朗普称伊朗协议“现已完成”，授权“开放”霍尔木兹海峡：原油跌逾4%，道指期货大涨380点
articles._zh_summary: 周日晚间，随着唐纳德·特朗普总统宣布结束与伊朗冲突的框架协议已经完成，美国股指期货飙升，油价暴跌。道指期货上涨 380.00 点，即 0.74%，至 51,607.00 点；标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨 72.25 点，即 0.97%，至 7,507.25；纳斯达克 100 指数期货上涨 480.25 点，即 1.62%，至 30,142.25 点。晚上 8:50美东时间。大宗商品方面，WTI 原油下跌 4.61%，至每桶 80.97 美元，布伦特原油下跌 3.92%，至每桶 83.91 美元。天然气期货下跌 1.92%，至每 MMBtu 3.06 美元。与此同时，追踪美元兑一篮子货币的美元指数报99.568，下跌0.24%。亚洲市场大幅走高，韩国综合股价指数上涨 5.51% 至 8,571.51 点，日本日经 225 指数上涨 4.87% 至 69,233.28 点。特朗普在《Truth Social》上表示，“与伊朗伊斯兰共和国的协议现已完成。”
